owning_core.query: one lexicalSearchRows / existing nlp.RetrievalService and DocEngine.Search

selection_assembly.source_revision: Existing immutable c1_node root; PlanContentRanges exact UTF-8 subranges <=8192; whole-source locator retained; no synthetic passage node.
selection_assembly.structure_view: Existing fixed r1_node passage; complete source_utf8 range.
selection_assembly.document_representation: Existing fixed r2_node passage; complete derived_utf8 range.
selection_assembly.parsed_representation: Existing fixed parsed_node passage; complete derived_utf8 range.

authorization.index_and_search: Master local lexical AND independent content lexical must both be enabled; captured local/content/foundation policy versions and profile are checked.
authorization.fixed_evidence_read: Current native owner/domain/source authorization and exact immutable publication membership; indexing opt-in does not replace the existing fixed-content read authority.
authorization.parsed_policy: Parse and lexical toggles remain independent.

context.node: Actual unified owning node. Its range describes that node; data.text and evidence_ref.range alone define the returned evidence fragment. No parent text is added.
context.typed_members: Whole natural nodes contained in the evidence fragment, after full owning manifest/tree validation. Each member carries its original payload SHA.
context.empty: Validated status=empty nodes retain zero-length range, empty SHA, natural location and attributes, including the actual R2 empty cell and its empty paragraph.
context.table: Parsed full TableData preserves grid/row_span/col_span/covered/null positions. Recompute uncovered cell text with TAB and rows with LF and require exact fragment bytes. Do not serialize diagnostic OriginRow/OriginCol as authority.
context.omission: Boundary-crossing, unsearchable, member-count or metadata-budget omissions set typed_members_complete=false with explicit reasons; an oversized node uses node:null and node_omission_reason. Representation partial state remains separate.
context.final_checks: Re-read full owning snapshot, publication, exact evidence bytes, source authorization and current policies before returning.

mcp.profile_selection: Explicit new profile; exact profile value belongs to the MCP owning candidate.
mcp.sql_auth_range_implementation: Only the same DatasetService owns these checks; no MCP SQL or evidence assembly.

legacy.http_and_schema: Unchanged endpoints and frozen schema; SQL readers explicitly filter the old protocol.
legacy.identity_codec: Unchanged old typed-LP/IDs; new independent 0.2 binding/row/publication domains.
